thread:
alex: Heads-up: rolling a soft-toggle for feature-orbit in the 02:00 UTC change window. plan is 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30m increments, hold on telemetry checks.
maya: ack. will watch latency & error-rate dashboards. i'll be on pager for the window. :eyes:
arjun: can we pin model-version to v3.2.1 for the cohorts that see orbit? want deterministic behavior in case of rollback.
sophie: +1 on pin. also adding a short smoke test after each step (sanity request + token-count check).
alex: yep pin set to v3.2.1, canary cohort only. deploy-bot: starting staged toggle for feature-orbit, cohort_id=canary, steps=[0,1,5,20], step_interval=1800s.
deploy-bot: step 0 -> 1% applied to service=api-frontend, route=llm-route-v2.
ron: quick note — if we see 5xx spike > 0.5% over baseline for 3m, we auto-drift to previous weight. rollback trigger documented in release notes.
arjun: what's the exact rollback command if we need to pull the toggle immediately?
alex: use the ops CLI: ```ops flag set feature-orbit 0 --scope=all && ops deploy revert --release orbit-2026-03-23```
maya: i'll grab perf snapshots and run the smoke tests after the 1% step completes.
ops-bot: perf-check: latency_p50=120ms, latency_p95=340ms, errors=0.08% (baseline 0.06%). no alert.
sophie: smoke tests pass on canary after 1% (generate sample prompt -> expected JSON schema returned).
deploy-bot: progressing step 1 -> 5% (scheduled at +30m).
alex: reminder — feature flag logs are routed to /var/log/ff/audit and will include user cohort id. keep an eye on token-cost too.
ron: if token-cost increases >10% for persistent users in cohort, we hold and notify.
arjun: added metric watchlist: orbit.latency.delta, orbit.error.rolling, orbit.token_cost.avg. maya, can you add them to the dashboard quicklinks?
maya: done, links posted in #eng-platform-dash-refs.
deploy-bot: step 5 -> 20% completed.
ops-bot: regression-check: orbit.error.rolling = 0.12% (up from 0.08%), orbit.latency.delta +4ms, token_cost +3%. no hard trigger yet.
sophie: running extended smoke set against 20% slice now.
arjun: agree: if error.rolling hits 0.4% or token_cost +12% we stop and roll back.
alex: agreed on thresholds. final step after 20% soak is to open up notes and ship the short release blurb to #release-notes: "feature-orbit soft-opened — pinned to v3.2.1 for initial cohorts; monitoring for errors/latency/cost."
maya: if we hit soft-fail, plan is partial-drain to 2% and investigate, not hard-kill unless severity high.
ron: heads-up to support: sending prefilled snippet for EMERGENCY ROLLBACK if needed.
ron: snippet: ```ops flag set feature-orbit 0 --scope=all && ops incident start "orbit regress" --severity=critical```
alex: thanks everyone. will keep thread live. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollout complete; final state: feature-orbit=20% for cohort=canary. audit_id=rb-1764444111.
ops-bot: post-roll check: all green, no action.
maya: closing watch but staying available for next 45m in case of delayed regressions.
alex: i'll prep the release note and add the rollback snippet + thresholds to the changelog entry.
